        "title": "ARC motif replication task family",
        "content": "ARC task family seen in Continual-ARC: sparse target-colored cells plus a small multicolor motif/template; outputs replicate the motif around each target. Demonstrations established target alignment can be identified by matching a distinctive template anchor: vertical [8,1,1] replicated with target aligned to middle 1; horizontal [8,3,9] with target aligned to center 3; vertical [0,0,3] with target aligned to center 0. Other demos show more complex motifs including background-colored cells within a bounding box, so carefully infer which cells are copied and anchor before stamping. Generate output with Python and validate row/column dimensions before submitting; several manual grid constructions here were malformed or wrong. For the e903b660 test, there were scattered 1 targets and a 3x3 source arrangement [4,5,5;8,5,8;8,5,0], centered around 5, but naïve centered replication attempts failed; likely anchor/template interpretation more nuanced.\n\nAdditional task-e903b660 recurrence (2026-10-21): Uniform noise background and numerous isolated marker cells, plus one small multicolor source motif. Demos confirm stamping source motif around each target, with a particular motif cell aligned to target; targets become that motif cell's color. Demo1 bg9, target6, motif [9 9 9;9 9 9;9 7 9;5 5 5] interpret carefully (source cluster near r9-11 c4-6); output stamp around each 6. Demo2 bg0 targets3, source motif 9 above vertical pair of 6; stamp aligned to upper 6 and targets become6. Demo3 bg1 targets6, 3x5 motif rows [9,3,3,3,9;9,8,9,7,9;3,3,8,3,3], aligned target to center 8; stamps all. Demo4 target4, source row [5,5,9] and stamps aligned at middle5. Demo5 target8, source row [5,2,5]; outputs motif centered on each8, replacing it with2. Demo6 target1, source motif around6, stamped target aligned to6. Demo7 target8, source motif around1: cluster has 3s/6s around central1; aligned target to1, replacing 8 with1. For future solve, first isolate the exact source motif and determine its anchor (often a distinctive central color, not the bounding-box center); stamp its non-background colored cells at each target, replacing target with anchor color. Crucially produce/submit output grid via programmatic JSON serialization; manual transcription repeatedly resulted in invalid ARC grid errors here. This task's test pattern at top-left was [[3,6,1],[9,3,7],[6,5,5]] embedded in bg5, and target markers were 0. I tried anchors central3 and 6/1 interpretations; all guesses failed, with several malformed manually copied grids. Anchor/template semantics remain unresolved; do not reuse my guessed test answer.",

Output copies aligned by template bounding-box center (relative (2,1)) to each 5. Current task: 3x3 object rows2-4 cols7-9, copy offset center to 5 at (3,1),(6,4). Preserve original. Identify the motif's exact colored-cell offsets from the seed; scan all translations whose motif offsets land on zeros, paint those offsets. Do not replicate at every zero anchor: only placements where all motif-offset cells in source grid are zero.",

        "title": "ARC paired-mask overlap task pattern",
        "content": "Observed ARC task family: inputs may contain two binary/noisy panels separated by a uniform divider, sometimes side-by-side, sometimes stacked. Output is the cellwise overlap of the foreground marks in each panel, recolored 2; output dimensions match one panel.
